Airline Group IAG Launches New Buyback to Complete Program
International Consolidated Airlines Group said it would buy back a further 500 million euros ($562.1 million) in shares, completing a program unveiled in February.
The company earlier this year committed to returning 1.50 billion euros of excess cash to shareholders to reduce its share capital.
The group, home to British Airways, Iberia and transatlantic airline Level, said Friday the new buyback would start on Oct. 5 and is expected to conclude no later than Feb. 27.
Qatar Airways has agreed to participate in the buyback to preserve the size of its roughly 25% stake in IAG, the British Airways parent said.
